summary.text: Lucas Hewitt is an independent candidate for Iowa House of Representatives District 61 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Vincent Collis.
A software developer from Waterloo, he said he would consider proposals from either party and post the reasoning behind his votes.

paragraphs.text: Lucas Hewitt graduated from Waterloo West High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Iowa in 2012; his career experience includes working as a software developer.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and raised in Waterloo, the son of a retired Waterloo police officer and a retired Iowa Department of Corrections probation officer, and that he worked in Christian ministry for several years before becoming an enterprise application developer.
He said he is married with three children and fosters animals with the Cedar Bend Humane Society.

Hewitt's survey answers listed three key messages: nonpartisan decision-making, transparent communication about his votes and decisions, and responsive representation, including personally answering constituent messages.
He said his focus is on collaboration and compromise around opposing viewpoints rather than on any single policy.
